name: Early buyer-seller balance reset
hypothesis: Buy after net flow moves from positive to neutral and back to positive without loss of the launch base.
spec: Setup: A launch may resume after initial holders transfer inventory to later buyers. Entry: Buy after net flow moves from positive to neutral and back to positive without loss of the launch base. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on renewed imbalance toward sellers or base failure. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
